read.title: Brief: #GlowUpRoutine Challenge
read.text:
Hi Daniel,

We're planning a two-week hashtag challenge on TikTok and Instagram to support our new vitamin serum. Participants will post a short video of their morning skincare routine with the hashtag #GlowUpRoutine.

We're hoping to reach 3,000 entries. To build momentum, we'd like five micro-influencers to post on day one, followed by a reminder post from our brand account in week two. Every participant will receive a 10% discount code, and ten winners will get a full-size serum.

Could you send us a draft timeline and a budget estimate by Friday?

Best,
Minsu

write.en: Write a short social media post inviting followers to join a hashtag challenge for a new sunscreen.
write.model: Join us in our #SunSafeSelfie challenge! Post a selfie with your favorite outdoor look, tag us, and add the hashtag #SunSafeSelfie. Every participant gets a 15% discount code, and five lucky winners will receive our new daily sunscreen. The challenge runs until December 10. We can't wait to see your posts!
